name: PHA-57378
summary: 3 nM at 5-HT2C. It has anxiolytic effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: PHA-57378 is a drug related to the ibogalogs which acts as an agonist at serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, having a binding affinity of 4.1 nM at the 5-HT2A subtype and 4.3 nM at 5-HT2C.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied for anti-anxiety effects in animals. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，曾在動物實驗中研究抗焦慮作用，並非藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，曾在动物实验中研究抗焦虑作用，并非药物。

fact.en: It belongs to the ibogalogs, simplified versions of ibogaine from the West African iboga shrub, made to keep the useful effects without the full complex structure.
fact.zh: 它屬於 ibogalog 類，是西非伊波加灌木中伊波加因的簡化版本，目的是保留有用的作用，而不必保留完整的複雜結構。
fact.zhHans: 它属于 ibogalog 类，是西非伊波加灌木中伊波加因的简化版本，目的是保留有用的作用，而不必保留完整的复杂结构。
